The exact successive-coordinate ratio gives orbitwise y_n=a z_n+d z_n^2+O(z_n^3), d=aq+a^2(alpha-1-p). Reciprocal expansion gives u_(n+1)-u_n=c+k z_n+O(z_n^2), c=q+alpha a, k=alpha a[2q+a(3alpha/2-1-p)]; the z_n^2 remainder is summable. Two summations yield 1/z_n=cn+(k/c)log n+C_initial+o(1), and n y_n->a/c. Zero correction occurs exactly at p=3alpha/2-1+2q/a when positive. Independent direct iteration with (a,q,alpha)=(2,1,1) and p=1,3/2,4 up to n=250000 verified both signs, vanishing k, quadratic slaving and stabilization of the corrected finite part; these finite checks do not prove universal asymptotics.
